title: Oliver Wyman - Digital - AI Product Engineer - Dubai/Abu Dhabi
description: Who We AreOliver Wyman Digital is a dedicated practice within Oliver Wyman, we deliver world-class products that give our clients a competitive edge and our mission is to leave a positive impact on the world. We have mixed agency skills with our consulting roots in order that we can best answer some of the largest companies’ toughest questions. Our global dynamic team deliver at the highest levels across many specialist skill sets including Design, Data Science & Analytics, Project Delivery and Engineering. We’re committed to growth that provides our people the most exciting and fulfilling opportunities and we are looking for more people to join us.The Role And Responsibilities - AI Product EngineerAs an AI Product Engineer, you will build the AI products and agentic solutions behind Oliver Wyman's AI-first transformation work, for our clients and for the firm. You own how an AI product is built, secured, and made reliable: from data and retrieval, through agent orchestration and integration, to user interfaces, deployment, evaluation, and ongoing improvement.You will work in small, multidisciplinary teams alongside AI Product Owners, consultants, industry experts, and client teams, building on live engagements. The role suits engineers who want to ship production-grade AI, see its business impact first-hand, and develop the breadth to lead complete AI products.What You Will Do Full-stack AI products: Develop and integrate user interfaces, backend services, and APIs into complete AI applications, applying appropriate frontend frameworks and user experience principles. Agent development and context engineering: Build single and multi-step agents with tools, state, memory, and human checkpoints. Design, test, and optimize agent instructions, context, memory, and tool specifications to improve task completion, reliability, latency, and cost. Reliable agent execution: Design agent workflows with durable state, resumability, failure recovery, safe retries, timeouts, and rollback or compensation for actions that cannot simply be reversed. Data and knowledge engineering: Build retrieval and knowledge pipelines, prepare structured and unstructured data, and design knowledge stores with appropriate data quality, lineage, protection, and access controls. Architecture and integration: Design, build and deploy AI applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, including compute, storage, databases, networking and containerized services. Integrate with enterprise systems through APIs and standard integration patterns, supporting client cloud and on-premise environments. Security and AI safety: Apply secure engineering and least-privilege access, and design permission boundaries, handling of untrusted content, connector security, and isolation between clients or tenants. Support IT, Risk, and Legal approvals. Evaluation and operations: Build evaluation and regression-testing practices using representative tasks, execution traces, and production feedback. Monitor quality, latency, and cost; design for maintainable operations and work with client technology or platform teams to support products in production. Collaboration and client impact: Translate product objectives into sound technical decisions with AI Product Owners, explain trade-offs and risks to non-technical stakeholders, and prepare client teams to run what we build. Continuous improvement: Use AI coding tools productively while owning the quality of everything you ship, contribute reusable components and standards, and, as your experience grows, lead workstreams and mentor others.Skills And QualificationsWe hire across experience levels and assess what candidates can demonstrate. For early-career hires, the priority is strong coding fundamentals, hands-on AI application experience, and sound technical judgement. Complex architecture, production operations, and team leadership can develop with experience. We look for most of the following: A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated software engineering experience through employment, independent projects, coursework, or open-source contributions; production delivery experience is valued for more senior candidates. Strong coding skills in Python and/or TypeScript, including readable code, debugging, source control, and automated testing; exposure to code review and CI/CD is an advantage. Evidence of building working LLM-powered application or agent, using tools or APIs, retrieval, or prompt and context design, and being able to explain what worked and what failed. Ability to develop software components and integrate with APIs, with a willingness to grow across user interfaces, backend services, and full-stack delivery. Foundational data skills, including SQL and working with structured or unstructured information; deeper pipeline and knowledge engineering can develop in the role. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, including deploying applications, managing cloud services and working with containers, APIs and cloud infrastructure. Understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, networking, monitoring and cost optimization. A security-first mindset and awareness of AI-specific risks, such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, secrets exposure, and data leakage. Understanding of software testing and why agent outputs require scenario-based evaluation, including both expected and failed behaviours. Product curiosity and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues. Excellent written and verbal communication in English.Nice To Have Experience with multi-agent orchestration, complex enterprise integrations, vector or graph databases, or observability tooling. Experience with AWS services such as Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM and CloudWatch, or equivalent services on Azure or Google Cloud. Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., AWS CDK), automated cloud deployments and enterprise cloud security practices. Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks Experience in consulting, client-facing, startup, or regulated and government environments. A portfolio of code, working demos, or shipped products that illustrates individual contributions.Why work at Oliver Wyman?Working as part of our global, entrepreneurial company, you will do meaningful work from day one. We are looking for individuals who challenge the norm, and constantly strive to build something new for the firm and the world around us.At Oliver Wyman, there's no "one size fits all" - we hire exceptional people and help them thrive through a built-in support network, flexible career paths, and no artificial barriers to advancement.We have a collaborative, supportive and impactful team environment - we want you to bring your authentic self and enjoy working alongside diverse and down-to-earth colleagues who do serious work, but don't take themselves too seriously.Our Oliver Wyman Values We create breakthroughs to achieve the amazingBe braveWe stand behind our beliefs while exploring what drives them. We stand up for what is right and persevere through difficulty. We venture into the unknown, staying open to our greatest possibilities.Lead with heartWe build relationships with clients and colleagues that last, grounded in transparency, authenticity, and trust. We love what we do and have fun while we do it. And we combine this passion with rigor and skill to drive sustainable performance.Strive for breakthroughsWe bring deep expertise and profound curiosity to the pursuit of ambitious ideas and uncommon insights. We ask bigger questions, seek diverse perspectives, and challenge ourselves to find the most powerful and sustainable solutions.Work as oneWe succeed as a unified team of colleagues and clients, achieving together what separately would be beyond our reach. We care for and develop one another. We learn from differences, overcome divisions, and celebrate our shared achievements.Own our impactWe act as entrepreneurs and stewards of the firm. We own the journey, acting with integrity at every step. And we own our impact, holding ourselves to the highest standards to deliver stronger results for our clients, better opportunities for each other and lasting change for society.Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in more than 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. The firm has more than 7,000 professionals around the world who work with clients to optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh McLennan [NYSE: MMC]. For more information, visit www.oliverwyman.com. Follow Oliver Wyman on X @OliverWyman.Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: CapsLock: Creative Design Team Lead (AI & Performance Marketing)
description: Headquarters: Chișinău, Remote, Anguilla URL: http://capslock.global CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success. Role overview We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.  You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline. Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs. You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows. What you will work on Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output; Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade; Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert; Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives; Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations; Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools; Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows; Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches; Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation; Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks. Your must-haves You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you. 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig); Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches; Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses; Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy.
